messages:
Becca H.: Hey folks — opened PR #4332 to consolidate reviewer guidance and add a short "how to pick a reviewer" blurb to docs/OWNERSHIP.md. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4332. Would love someone to take a quick prose pass and someone to sanity-check the label suggestions. Hoping for merge during the 15:00 PT quick fixes window.

Omar H.: Happy to check the labels and anchors. I like adding a "needs-linkcheck" label; we should also add a one-line automation note so infra knows to run linkcheck on label.

Noah G.: I'll do a prose review. Quick skim looked fine but I'll make sure the rotation instructions are clear for on-call folks and that the examples don't assume too much context.

docs-ci-bot: Preview deployed: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-4332 (status: pending)

Becca H.: Thanks — I added two suggested labels in the PR metadata: needs-prose, needs-linkcheck. Also included a tiny FAQ item about "if you're the only reviewer on rotation".

Omar H.: One note: the FAQ item references "evening rotation" but we don't currently have anyone assigned after 6pm. Recommend wording change to "after-hours coverage" and a pointer to OWNERSHIP.md where folks can sign up. Pushed a small suggestion to the branch.

Noah G.: Left two nit edits on phrasing and clarified how to choose a code vs prose reviewer for SDK snippets. Approving once the wording tweak applied.

Rina B.: I'm on merge duty for the 15:00 window and can click merge if CI is green and there are approvals. If needed I can also create backport PRs for the release branch.

docs-ci-bot: Preview deployed: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-4332 (status: failing — linkcheck: 1 broken anchor)

Becca H.: Broken anchor pointed to docs/OWNERSHIP.md#evening-rotation — I updated the anchor target in the branch to match the file. Pushed fix.

Omar H.: Re-run looks good locally. Approving.

Noah G.: Approved.

docs-ci-bot: Preview deployed: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-4332 (status: passing)

Rina B.: All green. Merging now for the 15:00 PT window. I'll also open a tiny follow-up issue to track adding the label automation for "needs-linkcheck".

Becca H.: Thanks everyone! I'll follow up with a short ping to #docs rotation and add a note to the onboarding checklist so new hires know how to sign up for after-hours coverage.

Omar H.: Nice. Small win for doc hygiene and fewer stray link-only PRs piling up.
